about: The entry id each corpus message that parsed got before SmsKind was added (finance revamp S1), captured with the parser as it was then, for user_id. sms_parser_test.dart checks they still parse to the same id, direction, amount and reference. Never regenerate it: a changed id is a duplicate entry on every phone.
